decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of size, design and position is considered to adversely impact on the amenity of the neighbouring property to the north through a reduction in daylight and outlook. The proposal is therefore contrary to the Residential Extension Guidelines and Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of size, design and position is considered to adversely impact on the appearance of the dwelling, as a result of the location of the extension and the excessive depth. The proposal is therefore considered contrary to the Residential Extension Guidelines and Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to a ground floor flat.
